name: @descix/frqtl-web
description: FRQTL for the browser — the discrete fractal physics engine (compiled Rust → WASM), its parts as ES modules, the scene doors (bootScene, bootProject) and frqtl-web.min.js.
exportsNotes: Every target is a file the build places at its lib-identity path (dist/frqtl/..., dist/shim/...), the same module a page imports by URL: one module, one URL. `.` is the parts barrel + the scene doors + the shared package core (lib/frqtl/boot-entry.js). `./boot` is the scene doors alone (doors.js); its node condition refuses, naming @descix/frqtl-node. `./parts` and `./parts/*` are the parts directory (one part = one file). `./project` is the specifier table, the link site, the project identity and the frqtl.json owner (lib/shim/project/index.js). `./registry` is the walk-through rungs, the showcase roster and the scene list. `./dist-manifest.json` is the per-file sha256 record a self-hosting consumer checks its copy against. dist/frqtl-web.min.js is a FILE, not an export: the esbuild IIFE of the same entry, global FRQTL. The expected shape of this map is owned by sdk/_build/exports-contract.mjs.

scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run verify:packages && npm run verify:build-closure && npm run verify:parity-core

notes: npm publish/pack runs from this directory. `files` is npm's native allowlist (dist/ is gitignored, but `files` bypasses .gitignore; src/, build.js and scripts/ stay home). `prepack` rebuilds dist/ and re-verifies BOTH FRQTL packages (sdk/_build/verify-publish-surface.mjs judges @descix/frqtl-web and @descix/frqtl-node together: they are one source built twice), so sdk/frqtl-node must be built first.
